title: Seamless Reaction Flow
summary: Alfredo has built the reaction-flow preview and would like Mendon to review the decision clarity and response timing.
review_steps: Extract the complete package and open Start Review.cmd. The prepared table uses real published cards and opens directly to Tamori Ruya’s reaction to Yoritomo Horibe’s bow.
Choose Ruya’s offered reaction, select a highlighted Personality, and use the named action button. Check that the exchange returns to play without a dismissal when no responses remain.
Cancel preparation with Escape and change targets before committing. Check the response context, continuation wording and stable decision area.
Use Other previews for the opposite seat and reduced motion. Open Full Game opens normal menus for broader play.
Record expected and actual behavior using Send Feedback.url. This scene is a test fixture; export is disabled because its initial position cannot be reconstructed as a normal replay.
known_limitations: Review candidate; rules-lead acceptance and native Windows graphical play remain pending.
Prepared review positions use published cards in an isolated fixture, rather than the pinned Lion/Crane deck list.
Authoritative reaction timing and optional passes are preserved. The package does not add a pass preference or change when responses are legal.
The Mac native input matrix is incomplete because the test desktop was locked. This preview remains a draft candidate pending those checks and human review.
